description: Register a new App Store Connect account. Provide the Key ID, Issuer ID, and an absolute path to the `.p8` file. The key file stays on disk — the MCP records only its path.

issuerId.description: The Issuer ID shown on the same page — a single UUID per developer team.

keyFile.description: Absolute path to the `.p8` private key file you downloaded from App Store Connect. Must remain readable at this path.

keyId.description: The Key ID from App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations (e.g. 'AB12CD34EF').

name.description: Short identifier used to switch accounts (e.g. 'acme-app', 'client-b').

name: accounts_add
